reviewType: AI semantic review; not human-expert ground truth
primaryCoverage: All proposed label changes, ambiguity flags and cited counterparts; all new360 definitions/memberships; root281 relation/abstract definitions and old place/multilabel definitions individually inspected. limitations: Project taxonomy revision, not human-expert linguistic ground truth.
No label was changed because it was a validation/test prediction error.
Scores under new labels are not directly comparable with old-policy percentages on other cohorts.

freshnessReview.method: Review of source-word/family identities and top35 old-meaning cosine neighbors; no model predictions or performance used.
